clue.text: Adder in season?

definitions.meaning: read literally, one who adds figures up, a totter of sums
the warmest quarter of the year, between spring and autumn

explanation.surface: A snake appears at a particular time of year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Adder' looks like the snake, but it is someone who adds, one who does sums.
explanation.definitionFit: One who does sums is a summer by literal word-building; the season sense is the plain one.

clue.text: Southern river or track

parts.note: the Po is Italy's longest river
taken as written

explanation.surface: A choice between following a southern river or a path.
explanation.definitionFit: The trail left by an animal, its prints or scent, is something a hunter follows.

clue.text: Effeminate fellow extracts money from work

parts.note: to milk someone is to drain cash from them
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A weak man squeezes cash out of his job.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated insult for a timid, unmanly man, a weakling or sissy.

clue.text: Text miser arranged for'a a radical

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are set out afresh in another arrangement

explanation.surface: Rearranging a stingy man's text produces an extreme thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' signals rearranging TEXT MISER; 'for'a a' is the OCR'd link 'for a'.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe a person holding views far outside the mainstream.

clue.text: Officer Commanding Eastern group is a beast

parts.note: OC is the military abbreviation for officer commanding
a lot is a batch or group of things

explanation.surface: A commanding officer leads an Eastern unit that behaves like an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A spotted wild cat of the Americas, an example of a wild animal.

clue.text: Third rate girl is none the less'in form

parts.note: C is the third grade after A and B, so a third-rate mark
lass is a northern word for a girl

explanation.surface: A mediocre girl is nevertheless in good shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is none the less' is a long link; 'less'in' is OCR for 'less in'.
explanation.definitionFit: A school form is a class of pupils, a year group taught together.

clue.text: Hide article, in king's play

indicators.note: the article is put inside the name of the play, which holds it

parts.note: King Lear is Shakespeare's play about an aged king
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: An article is concealed within a play about a king.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal's hide, once tanned, becomes this material for shoes and bags.

clue.text: Nice latch designed for professional

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are designed into a new pattern

explanation.surface: A tradesman fits a well-made door catch.
explanation.definitionFit: Technical means relating to a particular trade or specialist skill, as an expert would.

clue.text: Company left after time and put things in order

parts.note: late means past the due hour

explanation.surface: A firm departed past the deadline and tidied up.
explanation.definitionFit: To collate is to gather pages and arrange them in sequence.

clue.text: Scales in harmony

definitions.meaning: a weighing device with two pans
a state of equilibrium where parts are well proportioned

explanation.definitionFit: A weighing device with two pans is this instrument, and steady equilibrium between parts is also called this.

clue.text: Frightening the bird round the top of the tree

indicators.note: the bird's name goes round the letter, enclosing it

parts.note: a starling is a common speckled songbird

indicators.note: the top of a word is its first letter in a down clue

explanation.surface: A bird circles the crown of a tree, alarming onlookers.
explanation.definitionFit: Startling is alarming or causing a sudden shock, as a fright does.

clue.text: Programme for the future before us

indicators.note: the first piece is placed in front of the second

parts.note: a prospect is an outlook or what lies ahead
taken as written

explanation.surface: A plan of what lies ahead for us all.
explanation.definitionFit: A brochure setting out a scheme or offer, such as a share issue, is a published plan.

clue.text: Rearmost animal

definitions.meaning: at the back, as in the back legs

explanation.definitionFit: Hind legs are the back ones, and a hind is a female red deer.

clue.text: Island with better Religious Instruction

parts.note: to cap is to better or outdo
RI is the abbreviation for religious instruction, a school subject

explanation.surface: An island where religious teaching is superior.
explanation.definitionFit: A resort isle in the Bay of Naples, Italy.

clue.text: Rotary movement shows the time to be sagacious

parts.note: a clock is what tells the time
wise means sagacious

explanation.surface: A turning motion is the sensible way to tell time.
explanation.definitionFit: Turning in the direction a timepiece's hands go describes a kind of rotation.

clue.text: Confine soldiers observing exact rules

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
strict means sticking closely to rules

explanation.surface: Soldiers are kept in by sticklers for regulations.
explanation.definitionFit: To restrict is to limit or keep within bounds.

clue.text: Transfix the money maker with something to chew

parts.note: to spear is to pierce or transfix
the Mint is where coins are produced

explanation.surface: Pin down the coin producer with some gum.
explanation.definitionFit: A mint-flavoured gum or sweet chewed for fresh breath.

clue.text: Somehow I stop Hal going here for treatment

indicators.note: the letters of the three words are rearranged in some way

explanation.surface: Somehow I prevent Hal from going to get medical care.
explanation.definitionFit: A ward or infirmary is the place patients go to be treated.

clue.text: Type of landing seen on Shrove Tuesday?

definitions.meaning: an aircraft's flat, wheels-up belly landing
Shrove Tuesday, before Lent, is traditionally when batter is fried and tossed

explanation.definitionFit: A belly landing flat on the runway shares its name with the fried batter disc eaten on Shrove Tuesday.

clue.text: Register In screen role

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the two words, running across their join

explanation.surface: Sign up for a part in a film.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrol is to sign up or put one's name on a list.

clue.text: End of deserter with a thin lock of hair

parts.note: a rat deserts, as rats leave a sinking ship
a tail is an end

explanation.surface: The tail end of a runaway with a wisp of hair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'End of deserter' is the deserter's tail, so RAT comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: A rat-tail is a narrow plaited strand of hair left long at the back.

clue.text: Flay the king living in sin

indicators.note: the king dwells inside the word that follows, held within it

parts.note: K is the abbreviation for king in chess

explanation.surface: Punish the monarch for cohabiting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'living in sin' suggests cohabiting, but SIN is the container.
explanation.definitionFit: To flay is to strip off the outer covering of hide.

clue.text: Progeny giving information on eastern allowance

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
a ration is a fixed allowance

explanation.surface: Children supplying facts about a ration from the East.
explanation.definitionFit: A generation is a set of offspring descended at one stage from parents.

clue.text: Dance with girl before work

indicators.note: the first piece comes in front of the second

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A girl dances before going to work.
explanation.definitionFit: A lively 19th-century ballroom dance in two-four time.

clue.text: Deep canoe possibly

indicators.note: the letters of the boat could possibly be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: A small boat out on deep water.
explanation.definitionFit: 'The deep' is a poetic name for the sea.

clue.text: Wonder when motoring organisation will appear in distance .

indicators.note: the organisation shows up inside the measure of distance

parts.note: a mile is a measure of distance
the RAC, Royal Automobile Club, is a British motoring breakdown organisation

explanation.surface: Amazing when breakdown recovery turns up out in the country.
explanation.definitionFit: A marvel or wonder is an event beyond natural explanation.

clue.text: A sapper in a money-making institution with a tower

indicators.note: the pair are placed inside the institution

parts.note: the Mint makes coins
RE, Royal Engineers, whose soldiers are called sappers

explanation.surface: A military engineer working at the coin factory, which has a tower.
explanation.definitionFit: A slender tower of a mosque from which the call to prayer is made.

clue.text: Excused from a ' small measure of exercise

parts.note: ex means from, as in ex works
an em is a printer's unit of measure
PT is physical training, exercise

explanation.surface: Let off from even a little bit of exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: Exempt means freed from a duty that others must do.

clue.text: has been purloined
